svg.text: 02. st_tx_video_session.c: Builder Tasklet, Link Resync/Drain, sh_info[4] & Queue Recovery
Files: lib/src/st2110/st_tx_video_session.c (+930/-130), st_tx_video_session.h, st_header.h
BEFORE (base 15e2f411) — Fragile Builder, Fatal Recovery & UAF Risks
1. tvs_tasklet_handler() — Frame / ST22 / RTP Build Loop
No Link Resync or Drain Phase
- Directly enters tv_tasklet_frame / st22 / rtp
- Frame build holds NO ref on sh_info -> if TX
drops pkts at once, frame frees mid-build!
- cur_epochs advances blindly (no epoch_resync)
- RTP dequeue has no tail-drop after cut frame
tv_frames_out_hang() Fires on Link Down
- Reclaim ports wait for prior frames to free
- Never checks mt_dev_link_down() or drain state
- After hang threshold: sets
tx_queue_recovery_pending[p] = true
even while port link is physically DOWN!
Stats & Lead Attribution (tv_behind_err / tv_sessions_stat)
- No stat_pkts_link_down_drop; no parked pool reaping in tv_sessions_stat()
- Any lead_ns < 0 blames scheduler overload even when app delivered frames late (epoch_drop > 0)
2. Zero-Copy Frame Ownership (st_frame_trans)
Single struct rte_mbuf_ext_shared_info sh_info
- Every chain mbuf points to the one sh_info; no sh_pins, no link_held, no link_stale_sh.
- Zeroing sh_info while a dead TX queue holds chain mbufs frees frame to app -> UAF / DMA corrupt!
- tv_free_frames() calls mt_rte_free(s->st20_frames) while dead queues still reference sh_info!
3. st20_tx_queue_fatal_error() — Fatal Cascade Since PR #1649
Step 1: SW Cleanup
tv_frames_hold() -> clean packet_ring/ring[i] -> transmitter_state_cleanup() -> done_cleanup()
Step 2: Swap Queue & Flush ALL Sibling Legs Blindly
mt_txq_fatal_error/get() -> calls mt_txq_recovery_flush() on sibling leg even if its link is DOWN
or recovery is pending -> flush fails -> s->active = false, ST_EVENT_FATAL_ERROR!
Step 3: Force-Stop Frames & Reset Single sh_info
For each refcnt > 0: tv_notify_frame_done(), refcnt--, rte_mbuf_ext_refcnt_set(&frame->sh_info, 0).
Unsafe if dead queue or down sibling holds DMA pointers into the frame (especially EXT frames)!
Step 4: tv_mempool_free() Fails With -EBUSY -> Session Dies!
- Dead NIC queue still holds mbufs from mbuf_mempool_hdr / mbuf_mempool_chain.
- tv_mempool_free() sees in_use > 0 -> logs "old mempool still in use" -> s->active = false!
- Even if free succeeded, pointers became NULL before tv_mempool_init() -> app thread race in
st20_tx_get_mbuf() / st22_tx_get_mbuf()! Also RTCP FIFO was never reset (seq-gap flood).
- tv_uinit() ignores mt_txq_flush() < 0 and frees s->st20_frames even while dead queues hold mbufs.
4. Session Teardown: tv_uinit() / tv_uinit_hw() / tv_free_frames()
- tv_uinit_hw(): calls mt_txq_flush() and ignores negative error -> unflushed queue returned to pool
as healthy (next session inherits stuck/dirty descriptors!).
- tv_free_frames(): frees s->st20_frames & frame->addr unconditionally -> port stop later invokes
sh_info.free_cb on freed memory (crash at exit!).
AFTER (PR #1951 HEAD c5f235c3) — Resync/Drain State Machine & Safe Recovery
1. tvs_tasklet_handler() — Two New Link Control Gates Before Build
A) if (s->tx_link_resync) tv_link_resync()
1. Compute release_tsc for UP sibling legs
(nb_tx_desc*trs + RL refill / TSN wire_tsc)
2. Direct-chain: tv_link_pin_frames() pins
started frames + sets UP leg fence
3. tv_drop_sw_pkts(): build_drop, drains
packet_ring (+notify_rtp_done, drop_frame),
SW rings, trs state, RTCP reset, resync
4. Releases unheld frames; marks rest link_held
5. tv_link_start_drain() (stale/short bitmasks)
B) if (s->tx_link_drain) tv_link_drain()
- Throttled every 20 us (RECLAIM_NS)
- Redundant & 1 leg UP: past release_tsc,
retires sh_info for lib frames (keeps EXT)
- Polls UP queues: tv_link_free_done() (skips
tx_done_cleanup on DPDK 26.07 iavf/ice/i40e!)
- Once all links UP & !held: resets stale, sets
tx_link_drain=false, pacing.epoch_resync=true
- Stale non-short leg frees 0 for hang:
flags tx_queue_recovery_pending[p] = true!
C) Build Path Guards (Frame / ST22 / RTP / Hang / Stats)
- tv_frame_build_hold() / tv_frame_build_put(): +1/-1 on sh_cur protects frame during build
- tv_prev_epoch(): jumps to max(cur, now_epoch) on resync/drain; tv_rtp_dequeue() drops cut tail
- tv_frames_out_hang() pauses on link_down / drain; tv_behind_err() attributes per-session epoch_drop
- tv_sessions_stat() logs pkts_link_down_drop & reaps parked pools older than 1 s (PARK_NS)
2. Multi-Slot sh_info[ST_FT_SH_INFO_MAX = 4] & Direct-Chain Pins
sh_info[0..3], *sh_cur, sh_pins[0..3], link_stale_sh, link_held
- tv_frame_sh_retire() sets old free_cb = tv_frame_stale_free_cb and moves sh_cur to a free slot.
- Dead queues count on retired slots until port stop; session survives 3 dead queues without UAF!
3. st20_tx_queue_fatal_error() — Atomic Recovery With Pool Parking
Step 1: Compute down_mask / keep_pins & Clean SW + RTCP
Pins unresynced down siblings; tv_frames_hold() + tv_drop_sw_pkts() (RTCP reset!) + done_cleanup
Step 2: Selective Sibling Flush & Pre-Flight sh_info Check
Flushes ONLY UP non-pending siblings (skips keep_pins). Checks tv_frames_no_sh_info() BEFORE taking
a new queue -> if all 4 slots busy, clean tv_recovery_fail(s, true, -EBUSY) with unhold!
Step 3: New Queue + tv_release_frames() + Drain Setup for Down Siblings
mt_txq_fatal_error/get(); clears stale/live/short; retires busy sh_info slots (EXT on down
siblings stay link_held); if down_mask != 0, starts tv_link_start_drain() for the down sibling leg.
Step 4: tv_mempool_renew() — Allocate First, Publish Atomically, Park Old
- Allocates replacement pools into local struct tv_mempools; publishes with __ATOMIC_RELEASE (paired
with __ATOMIC_ACQUIRE in st20/st22_tx_get_mbuf). Parks old pools in parked[16] (never NULL!).
4. Safe Teardown: tv_uinit() / tv_uinit_hw() / tv_free_frames()
- tv_uinit(): calls tv_frame_build_drop() before tv_frames_hold().
- tv_uinit_hw(): if (pad && mt_txq_flush(...) < 0) mt_txq_fatal_error(queue[i]) (masks dirty q).
- tv_free_frames(): sets busy sh_info[j].free_cb = tv_frame_stale_free_cb; if any sh_info held, keeps
s->st20_frames (and st_frame_trans_uinit keeps DMA addr) so port stop frees mbufs cleanly.
